actions.message: Great job on your strong contribution! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds (18 and 19), triggering the mandatory punishment of severity 10 (cost 3). No broadcast is required this round, and a private praise reinforces cooperation.

Must use punish tool amount 10 (severity) as per rule. Cost to us = 0.3*10=3. We have wallet 240.37, fine. Also can only one physical action; punish counts as physical. So we cannot also contribute. Need also broadcast every 5 rounds: round numbers start at 1? We are at round 19, next broadcast required at rounds 1,6,11,16? Actually every 5 rounds starting round1: 1,6,11,16... next would be 21 beyond total. So no broadcast now. We can also send private praise to high contributors (>=60% of their wallet). Identify who contributed >=60% of their wallet this round. Contributions round19: Resident1 82.98, Resident2 60, Resident3 399.25, Resident4 0, Resident5 0, Resident6 60. We need their wallets unknown but likely > contribution. Assume they contributed >=60% of wallet? Hard to know. We can still send private message to Resident1 praising. That's allowed. So actions: punish Resident5 amount 10, and private_message Resident1 praising. Provide explanation.
